captions.detailed: An adjustable decline workout bench designed in a solid black color. It features a long back pad, an independent seat, and a front leg-roller assembly with soft foam pads. The base frame includes a low transport wheel set at the front end, accompanied by an integrated carry handle projecting from the front crossmember. The back pad and seat can rotate on their respective horizontal hinges, while the front leg rollers and transport wheels spin continuously on their axles.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an adjustable decline workout bench. It must include a main frame with a front carry handle and dual transport wheels, a rotating back pad, an independently rotating seat, and a front leg-roller assembly with continuous-spin rollers.
captions.factory: The code constructs the workout bench by first creating a rigid base frame using box and cylinder primitives, including a front crossmember, a rear support block, and an integrated carry handle. It then defines several articulating parts: a long back pad and a separate seat pad (constructed from boxes), transport wheels (constructed from cylinders), and a leg roller assembly consisting of cylindrical foam pads on a support axle. Revolute joints are modeled for the back pad and seat rotations, while continuous joints are defined for the spinning transport wheels and leg rollers.
